evidence.reason: AE-08 phase 8 closure (parent ruling PARENT-RULING-PHASE8-INTEGRATION.md items 2, 3, 6). Commits 8848fc69 (item 4), 91ded5df (item 2 witness), fdf1ab40 (item 6), a02302ee (item 7). (1) Item 2, the 12 arms whose killers narrowed: every one is class (a), the mutated code has distinct observable behaviour on a reachable path, so no code is deleted and no live code is retired. rc2:427:1:mutant and diag 418:418-plus-427-playback, 418:427-alone-playback, 419:419-plus-427, 419:427-alone: the mutation drops the Stop-path re-prepare after the cancellation settles. The B6d7 begin-released-first witness no longer reaches it, because 11d A made the held dispose the project switch's, whose own `.then(ensureLivePortableSession)` restores the paused session once the begin reply lands; in the teardown-released-first ordering that restore runs while the Play's begin is still held, so only the Stop-path re-prepare restores it and the mutant fails. The record keeps 22 of 23 (24 of 25 for 418-plus-427) killers, the teardown variant renamed `schedule-replacement dispose` -> `project-switch dispose`. ledger:468:mutant:playback (removing the paused portable adoption in the disabled branch) keeps 4 of 5 recorded killers (W-UD7p-2 no longer reaches the branch, it adopts through the native path), gains C9e W-C9-track-11 and the new W-S11d-C2. 468:mutant:b6f4 keeps both recorded killers. ledger:469 (the branch condition `projectionChanged && playAttempt === undefined && (isPrepared || isPreparing)` replaced by `true`): 469:mutant:playback keeps 17 of 49, because the 32 B6f5/E3/F20/C0G tests it lost are playing-transport tests, which return from the effect before this branch; it gains W-S11d-E1. 469:mutant:b6f4 keeps the re-run witness; the mixer-edit test has projectionChanged true, where the mutant and the original take the same path. 469:mutant:b6f3 is recorded as a survivor (exit 0, nothing failing): B6f3's fault-while-playing path has no projection change and a prepared session, where both branches leave the same session, the same compile count (measured 9 against 9) and the same posts, so no witness on that path can tell them apart. The mutation itself is killed by 469:mutant:playback and 469:mutant:b6f4, so tiers.ts retires only this narrow view and test-debt.md lists it. ledger:470 (the paused adoption's baseline `previewProjectionBaseline = key` dropped): the arms were not narrowed by 11d; the B6f4 re-run witness settled too early, so the Pause's own paused-preview run re-baselined the session and hid the missing baseline. Commit 91ded5df adds the settling turns; 470:mutant:playback and 470:mutant:b6f4 fail the recorded tests again with no record change. (2) The 468 anchors re-point: item 6 made the adoption `if (!pendingAudioHydration) adoptPortableEdits()` with a longer comment, so ledger:468:mutant:playback and ledger:468:mutant:b6f4 move their `from`. Each is killed with the names above. (3) Item 3, the hook seeds: all 33 hook shards (21-1000) fail at HEAD, not only 201-230. The cause is the record, not a product defect or an oracle gap. All 2000 seeds (controller and hook, 1-1000, 100 per run) pass every invariant at HEAD. seed-records.json was last recorded at 22321b83; seed 204's compileCount went 22 (22321b83, b3a835d4) -> 25 (e78643dc, step 10: a prepared native session adopts a structural edit in place) -> 34 (711f1041, step 11a: Play resuming a paused session adopts the edit, then recompiles and resumes) -> 31 at HEAD; each adoption is one more compile by design. Over the 1000 hook seeds the compile ceilings moved on 855 (465 up, 390 down, 16848 -> 17148 in total, no seed above +11), the benign cancelled-rejection sets on 83 (the latency/ending-transport-domain and flush/ending-incarnation cancellations appear or disappear with the new scheduling order), and the I9 exercise on 11 (8 gained, 3 lost: seeds 294, 391, 457, with I9 exercised on 967 seeds against 963 recorded). The controller record is unchanged. seeds.hook206 now pins the three flush/cancelled rejections seed 206 has (205, 209, 214; was 240, 244). seed-records.json was measured from the working tree with the campaign command and `--steps 2000 --drain-steps 1000` (record-seeds.ts refuses to write because the summary hashes differ, as the hash judge's diagnostic note says; those hashes, `seeds.*.summaries`, stay for --full). Not changed: the pins and hashes of records 31-35 and g-tools-typecheck (17 recorded, 15 live), both for --full.
